newsitem.title: USA: Lamar to buy some Outdoor Systems assets.
newsitem.headline: Lamar to buy some Outdoor Systems assets.

text.p: Lamar Advertising Co on Monday said it reached a tentative agreement to buy certain assets from Outdoor Systems Inc for $115 million.

Lamar is buying some of the assets that Outdoor System had agreed to buy as part of its proposed acquisition of Minnesota Mining & Manufacturing Co's National Advertising Co, Lamar said in a statement.
An Outdoor Systems spokesman said the sale of the properties was to enable its $1 billion deal with National Advertising Company to clear antitrust reviews.

The acquisition is contingent on completion of Outdoor System's acquisition of National Advertising and other customary closing conditions, including execution of a definitive agreement and expiration or early termination of the waiting period under the Hart-Scott-Rodino Antitrust Improvements Act.

The pending acquisitions bring Lamar into the markets of Atlanta, Denver, Detroit, Grand Rapids, Mich., Houston, New Orleans, Kansas City, Louisville, Ky., Phoenix, and Sacramento, Calif, the companies said in separate statements.

The acquisition is expected to add approximately 1,800 displays to Lamar's current display count of approximately 40,000. Both the number of displays and purchase price are subject to change before finalization of the transaction.
After the transaction, Outdoor Systems will operate 94,000 display faces in 46 states.
